description: Whitespace family (crates/twig-fuzz/src/generators/whitespace.rs): accepted deviation D2 (reference/deviations.md, Engine: "Lone CR bytes in the generated PHP") reached through `{% line %}` after a raw CR inside a tag. The marked vector is minimised from ws-11-4917; the three controls drop one ingredient each (the `\r` escapes, the raw CR, the `{% line %}`) and must keep matching. The generator no longer writes `\r` escapes (CR bytes come from the data instead). Recorded with "isolation": "process".

known_mismatch.reason: Accepted deviation D2 (reference/deviations.md, Engine: "Lone CR bytes in the generated PHP"; research/fuzzing.md (history: git log -- plans/parity-fixes.md), accepted deviations: follow-ups). The `\r` escapes of `"\r\n x \r"` put CR bytes into string literals of the compiled PHP (`Compiler::string()` does not escape them); PHP's scanner counts them as line breaks while `Compiler` counts only LF for `getDebugInfo()`, so `Error::guess()` maps the failing `escape('js')` of the `apply` (template line 2: the raw CR of `{%~endfor\r-%}` is a newline for the lexer) to the `// line 1` marker that `{% line 1 %}` produced inside the captured body. twig-rs reports line 2, which is what PHP reports without the CR escapes (control ws-d2-control-no-cr-escape). Stays marked by design.
